name: Panisse
steps: Whisk chickpea flour into cold water until smooth. Add salt and 20 ml of the measured olive oil.
Cook over medium-low heat for 12–15 minutes, stirring constantly, until a very thick paste pulls away from the pan sides.
Spread 2 cm thick in an oiled tray, flatten the top and chill at least 2 hours until firm. Cut into sturdy fingers.
Heat remaining olive oil in a wide skillet and shallow-fry in batches 3–4 minutes per side until both faces have a deep golden crust.
Drain briefly, add black pepper and serve hot with lemon wedges; the center should remain tender and creamy.
tips: Chill the slab until truly firm; warm paste will fall apart in the skillet.
passiveTime: Chill 2 hours to set before frying.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
